name: Clarice
source:
She is a eldest daughter of a family that has produced knights to protect the kingdom. As a knight, she was raised to be more manly than a man. She is princess Elise's personal attendant and guard. When it comes to the princess, she is overprotective of her and takes care of her even though she is not her maid.

She presents herself as a gentleman with a strong sense of chivalry, this makes her popular among the female students. On matters pertaining to love she is extremely naive. She has a complex regarding her body, which has recently become more feminine.
